import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { artist } from "./artist";
import { artistCredit } from "./artist_credit";

// Introspected as an owned-child: belongs to artist_credit (its only foreign key inside the primary key) and nothing else references it.
// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "name" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
export const artistCreditName = defineTable("artist_credit_name", {
    columns: {
        artistCredit: col.integer().primaryKey(),
        position: col.smallint().primaryKey(),
        artist: col.integer().notNull(),
        name: col.text().notNull(),
        joinPhrase: col.text().notNull().default("")
    },
    relations: {
        artistRelation: rel.belongsTo(() => artist, { localKey: "artist", onDelete: "cascade" }),
        artistCreditRelation: rel.belongsTo(() => artistCredit, { localKey: "artist_credit", onDelete: "cascade" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
